title: 34.4 A 9.05-to-37.0GHz LO Generator with Magnetic Mode Switching and Tuning-Free Octave-Bandwidth Common-Mode Resonator Achieving >190.7dBc/Hz FoM
problem: VCOs with octave-plus tuning range (>10GHz center frequency) face challenges maintaining low phase noise while spanning wide frequency coverage; multi-core multi-mode architectures are complex and require extensive tuning.
motivation: Multi-band communications, software-defined radios, and electronic warfare require universal frequency synthesis spanning octave bandwidths; wide tuning range with low phase noise is critical.
method: An octave-bandwidth VCO uses magnetic mode switching to transition between operating bands and implements a tuning-free common-mode resonator with automatic frequency tracking across the full tuning range, eliminating manual mode transitions.
key_novelty: Automatic magnetic-mode-switching architecture with tuning-free octave-bandwidth common-mode resonator eliminating complex mode manual control.
contributions: Magnetic mode switching enabling seamless transitions across octave frequency ranges
Tuning-free common-mode resonator maintaining resonance across full tuning range
Automatic resonance tracking removing manual mode-switching complexity
limitations: Power consumption, phase-noise vs. frequency, and integration with frequency synthesizer not detailed.
primary_theme: Automatic magnetic-mode VCO with tuning-free octave-bandwidth resonator
